items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: The interviewee discusses Kid Rene. The mention of 'Nancy' is solely by the interviewer addressing her ('Go ahead, Nancy') to end the recording or pause. The interviewee does not speak to Nancy, nor does he mention her in relation to himself or Kid Rene.

ctx.x: He wasn't too loud of a man, he was a soft type fellow. Make plenty of variations on his trumpet. He's a nice sweet trumpet player, he's a fine fellow.
Go ahead, Nancy, we'll turn it off. We were talking about Kid Rene. Yes sir. Some people told me he was specialized in high notes. Do you remember when you played with him? Was he a high notes man?
Yes, yes, at that particular time, yeah, when he was at the Levita. When he first started there he was a pretty high note man, but a job like that, Mr. Bill.
